note: Isaiah wave I-5, chapter 28 Editor. Read base: central v4.0.0 (read-only, grep only). Contents: 5 modify ops, appliesTo extensions with rationale addenda; no wohChoice, claim_type or existing rationale text changed, so a minor bump. (1) kalah-venecheratzah-decreed-full-end-cross-corpus + ISA-28:22 (the forward commitment of the entry, wave I-5 rule 2). (2) karat-brit-cut-covenant + ISA-28:15: the entry names Isa 28:15 and governs karat brit 'throughout the Hebrew Bible'; the draft's 'made a covenant' is changed to 'cut a covenant'. (3) sheol-underworld-realm-of-the-dead + ISA-28:15, 28:18. (4) mot-mavet-death-personified-cross-corpus-ugaritic-hebrew-bible + ISA-28:15, 28:18, apparatus-only, as at 25:8. (5) adam-adamah + ISA-28:24 (ʾaḏmāṯô 'his ground'). DELIBERATE NON-EXTENSIONS: eretz is not extended to 28:2 (lāʾāreṣ 'to the ground' is the falling idiom the eretz rationale already excludes at 21:9) nor to 28:22 (cosmic scope governed by the overlay eretz-cosmic-scope-isaiah-24, as 10:23). kalah-venecheratzah is not extended to 28:27 ḥārûṣ 'threshing sledge', a homonym.

rationaleAppend: isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 28:22 kî-ḵālāh wᵉneḥĕrāṣāh šāmaʿtî … ʿal-kol-hāʾāreṣ is printed 'for a full end, and that determined, I have heard from the Lord YHWH of hosts, upon the whole earth', departing from ASV 'a decree of destruction' as this entry forecast (ASV on getbible.net; JPS 1917 'an extermination wholly determined'; NJPS 'a decree of destruction'; Sefaria; all checked 2026-11-26). The formula is now recognisable at Isa 10:23, 28:22 and Dan 9:27. The adjective ḥārûṣ 'sharp', used as the noun 'threshing sledge' at Isa 28:27 (BDB s.v. ḥārûṣ I, 'Is 28:27 … 41:15'), is a homonym of the participle and is not governed by this entry.

isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 28:15 kāraṯnû ḇᵉrîṯ ʾeṯ-māweṯ is printed 'We have cut a covenant with death', as this entry's own rationale already renders the verse. ASV, JPS 1917, Koren and NJPS have 'made a covenant' (checked 2026-11-26). The parallel ʿāśînû ḥōzeh (ʿśh) keeps 'we have made an agreement', so the two verbs stay distinct. At 28:18 the noun bᵉrîṯ occurs without kāraṯ ('your covenant with death will be annulled') and is not governed here.
isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 28:15, 18 'with She'ol we have made an agreement' / 'your agreement with She'ol will not stand' (ASV 'Sheol'; JPS 1917 'the nether-world'; NJPS 'Sheol'; checked 2026-11-26).

isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 28:15, 18 bᵉrîṯ ʾeṯ-māweṯ 'a covenant with death', parallel to She'ol. As at Isa 25:8, the line prints lower-case 'death' (NJPS personifies it as 'Death'; ASV, JPS 1917 'death'; checked 2026-11-26), and the comparison with Ugaritic Môtu as a treaty partner, together with the alternative reading of the phrase as a sarcastic name for the Egyptian alliance (Isa 30:1-7; 31:1-3), is carried in commentary only.
isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 28:24 yᵉp̄attaḥ wîśaddēḏ ʾaḏmāṯô 'open and harrow his ground' (ASV).
